info.name: SS-6394 PREPROD Book/Info only
info.description: Existing real bookings; Book/Info only. User authorized TLS verification disabled for this PREPROD host/run only. Authentication must be set locally. CSV assertions cover observed ticket-defined structure; full source numeric parity is not certified.

exec: const owner=pm.iterationData.get('provider_filter')||pm.variables.get('scenario_owner');const ptc=owner==='AA'?'JCB':'ADT';for(const s of ss||[]){pm.test('Checked breakdown and prefixes',()=>{const b=s.baggage[ptc];pm.expect(b.numberOfPcs).to.match(/^\d{2}P$/);pm.expect(b.baggageFullTextA).to.match(/^FBA/);pm.expect(b.baggageFullTextD).to.match(/^FBD/);});if(s.carryOn&&s.carryOn[ptc])pm.test('Carry-on prefixes',()=>{pm.expect(s.carryOn[ptc].baggageFullTextA).to.match(/^COA/);pm.expect(s.carryOn[ptc].baggageFullTextD).to.match(/^COD/);});}

const expected=pm.iterationData.get('expected_segments_json');if(expected){pm.test('Reviewed expected values',()=>{for(const e of JSON.parse(expected)){const s=ss.find(v=>v.tripId===e.tripId&&v.segmentNumber===e.segmentNumber);pm.expect(s).to.exist;for(const k of ['baggageAllowance','baggage','carryOnAllowance','carryOn'])if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(e,k))pm.expect(s[k]).to.deep.equal(e[k]);}});}
